entityDescription:
Lever Development Consultants S.A. is a consulting company for the development and increase of efficiency, operating in the private and public sector.
The Mission of Lever Development Consultants S.A. is the effective support of the life quality improvement of Greek citizens, along with the development of the national economy by influencing the most critical sectors of the local society, via consulting services.
The operation of Lever Development Consultants S.A. is based on the following basic values that characterize its corporate style and determine the modus operandi in order to achieve its goals:
· Humbleness in our relationships with customers and partners
· Collaboration and synthesis of knowledge
· Unlimited interest in the support of our customers till their significant problems are resolved.
· Professionalism, high expertise and efficiency
The company’s philosophy includes the integrated approach to the advisory support of the customers towards the settlement their most important issues. This is ensured through the know-how and the experience of company’s executives, as well as via the strategic partnerships that have been developed with leading global companies in the field of Consulting, HR and new technologies/communications, such as Valueselling, Worldsview academy, Profiles International , Customer Focus, CISCO, OTE, WIND, NOVA, etc. andwith national leaders such as Samaras Group and Associates.
The Business Strategy of Lever Development Consultants S.A. includes:
a) development of a dense network of consultants with high geographical dispersion in order to support efficiently and spot safely the most important issues of our partners.
b) research and setting up of new services that create novel conditions for the optimum development of our partners.
c) continuous development of the executives through training , along with innovation in the work and cooperation mentality.
d) development of expertise through collaborations with the leading research institutions and bodies in Europe and America.
The Vision of Lever Development Consultants S.A. is to become the Consulting Company that has influenced most significantly and decisively the local development in our country and the improvement of the life quality of its citizens by 2030.

entityDescription:
Magellan Aerospace is a global aerospace company that has more than 60 years of space heritage providing innovative solutions for suborbital, Earth orbit, lunar and deep space missions. Magellan has expertise in the design and production of rapid and low-cost sounding rocket and microsatellite missions, science experiments aboard the Space Shuttle and the International Space Station, as well as spacecraft subsystems and small satellite bus platforms. Customers have included space mission primes from the commercial space sector, as well as government agencies such as NASA, the European Space Agency (ESA), the Canadian Space Agency (CSA), and the Canadian Department of National Defense (DND).
Magellan Aerospace offers a family of customizable spacecraft bus solutions consisting of the Microsatellite-class MAC-100, MAC-150 and the Smallsat-class MAC-200. Customizable for diverse mission needs, Magellan’s buses are rigorously designed and tested for high reliability and optimum mission performance. Magellan’s flight-proven satellite subsystem equipments can be found today on several Earth orbiting satellites as well as a deep space exploration missions.
On the ground, Magellan’s Canadian-based Advanced Satellite Integration Facility (ASIF) is a unique hub for innovation that turns Magellan’s investment in knowledge and technology into a global advantage for the advancement of our national space industry. Jointly operated with the University of Manitoba, ASIF connects industry with academia in the research, development, construction and testing of satellite buses and subsystems.

description:
At Moofind, we encourage digitalization of the livestock farming, to revolutionize existing practices. Our app enables farmers to remotely monitor the position and well-being of their cattle, as well as select optimal grazing areas, all from the comfort of their home. 
Traditionally, farmers have had to conduct physical inspections of fields to ensure their livestock remains within the paddock boundaries and to monitor their well-being. Additionally, determining optimal grazing areas has relied heavily on the farmers' experience and intuition, often requiring manual inspections. 
Our aim is to streamline operations, enhance productivity, and boost efficiency. Ultimately, this saves valuable time and reduces the daily workload for farmers, allowing them to focus on other important tasks.

entityDescription: ENTROPI.space Ltd. is focusing on advancing tools for microgravity research and simulations, with an emphasis on developing Random Positioning Machines (RPMs) that rotate biological or physical samples to simulate microgravity. Our RPMs are designed to function in challenging environments such as MRI, explosive, and chemically aggressive conditions, offering versatility for specialized experiments. Additionally, we are working on an initiative to provide more accessible zero-gravity flights using a monowing aircraft. This aircraft will be capable of handling up to 6 kg of payload, offering researchers a cost-effective alternative for conducting microgravity experiments, as zero-g flights on larger aircraft are often prohibitively expensive and require complicated planning. Furthermore, our goal is to provide the transport of Earth-tested samples to space stations for further experimentation in true microgravity conditions as a Samples-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution.

entityDescription: Our research combines the development of scalable photonic quantum technology for quantum computing and other quantum information applications with the investigation of fundamental quantum science questions. entityDescription:
LEAM Technologies GmbH is an innovative developer and provider of advanced additive manufacturing technologies based in Munich, Germany. The company offers a new add-on technology that enhances the extrusion additive manufacturing process by integrating localized radiation heating using focused beams of incoherent light. This technique ensures precise temperature control during the material extrusion process, enabling the production of parts with isotropic properties comparable to conventional manufacturing methods.
LEAM's technology primarily addresses the production of high-performance thermoplastics, which are essential in demanding sectors such as aerospace and space industries. The application of LEAM's system allows for the creation of complex geometries in critical structures, without the material waste associated with traditional manufacturing methods.
LEAM's technology introduces heat exactly where needed, ensuring optimal bonding of the material layers and preserving the stability of previously deposited layers. This approach not only enhances the material properties of printed parts but also significantly increases the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of the additive manufacturing process.
LEAM Technologies GmbH positions itself as a key enabler in the industrial adoption of AM by overcoming existing material quality limitations and setting new standards for material performance in additive manufacturing.

entityName: Centro Regionale Information Communication Technology scrl
description:
The “Regional Centre on Information Communication Technology - CeRICT scrl” is a company that acts in Information and Communication Technology (ICT) domain, with particular focus on the applied research projects.

CeRICT headquarter is placed in Benevento, town located in the middle of the Campania Region.

The Centre’s mission answers the regional and national productive network’s demand for medium and long term advanced research in the ICT sector. Its work is geared towards the technological transfer of results attained and the creation of new productive entities through spin-offs or the establishment of specific businesses.

CeRICT is an organization for accessing competencies and relationship within ICT national and international system. It derives from CRdC ICT project, which was set up at the end of the year 2002 as an initiative of the Campania Region. CRdC ICT project aim was to build a Competence Network in Information and Communication Technologies.

CeRICT was created by ten Partner, in particular by Universities and Public Research Centres of Campania Region, in order to increase their economical and social value by means of the application of their specific competencies. The aim of the CeRICT is to meet the medium and long-term research needs by the interaction of ICT firms, ICT big enterprises, small software houses, authority and public administrations. The mission of the CeRICT is to guide the results of the fundamental research (developed within the academic environment) towards applicative projects realized together with companies, in order to respond to ITC sector’s needs. The technological transfer of the results and the creation of new industrial companies (via spin-offs or specific company build-up) complete the background where the organization carries out its mission.

CeRICT is non profit and Cerict distribuites no profit its members in any way.

More than 200 Professors/Researchers/Technicians, from the Partners, are the “virtual” staff of the CeRICT. Structure of virtual connection that combines intellectual, scientific and entrepreneurial resources characterizing which node of the coordination of the activities of the Regional Program of Search. Each Partner works as an "access portal" to the whole set of competencies available in the region, for each specific area. The direction and management (planning and responsibility) is distributed in the whole region.

entityName: Institute of Psychology of The Czech Academy of Sciences
entityDescription:
The Institute of Psychology of the Czech Academy of Sciences focuses on research in the field of psychology in the Czech Republic with an international impact. The mission of the Institute of Psychology CAS, v. v. i. (founded in 1967) is to conduct scientific research on the human psyche, human behaviour, and functioning in general. We focus on studying human personality development, maturation, and functioning, social processes in small groups and large communities, and mental processes such as perception, attention, language, emotions, and motivation. We are engaged in the advancement of existing and the development of new methods of psychological research.
Our institute includes the Laboratory of Behavioral and Linguistic Studies (LABELS), where we conduct experimental studies in psychology and other behavioural sciences. The results of our research are published in international scientific journals, and we also publish our journal, Czechoslovak Psychology, which features articles in both Czech and English. We participate in organizing scientific conferences and educational events. In cooperation with universities (primarily Charles University and Masaryk University), we educate doctoral students in psychology and related fields. We operate a specialized library accessible to the public and popularize findings from psychological science through the media.

entityDescription:
Heaven Labs s.r.o. is a relatively young company focused on the development and production of nutritionally complete meals - Mana™. We produce and deliver nutritionally complete meals to the EU and nearly every corner of the world. Our nutritionally complete food can be ordered here: https://mojemana.cz/ . The goal of the long-term strategy of Heaven Labs s.r.o. is to reach a point where all products are produced within a closed environmental chain with zero carbon footprint. To achieve this goal, the company is seeking new ways to reduce waste, find the most eco-friendly packaging materials, and use more renewable energy in all production processes. As part of this effort, the company aims to find excellent nutrients for its products and become self-sufficient in their production. The research and development team is continuously working on improving the composition of the already produced foods and will also work on finding suitable ingredients and ensuring their in-house cultivation. As part of the long-term development, the company aims to develop new products that will be nutritionally rich and serve as a plant-based alternative to products from the traditional meat, bakery, and fishing industries. The development strategy includes clinical studies comparing the nutrient utilization of these products in the body to that of animal-based products.The design and research & development team proudly boasts experience from the prestigious NASA Deep Space Food Challenge, where they contributed to innovative solutions in food technology for space missions. The team developed a robust system for assembling, producing, and distributing nutritionally complete meals, capable of sustaining a four-member crew on a three-year mission in deep space. All of this was achieved with minimal energy requirements and maximum efficiency, while minimizing waste and reducing any negative impacts on the spaceship.
The company has thus capitalized on its 10 years of expertise in the field of nutritionally complete meals, along with its innovative spirit and commitment to advancing human knowledge, science, and technology as a whole.

entityDescription:
NOW Systems (Nologin Oceanic Weather Systems SLU) has a strong experience in operational oceanography, supporting services (using regional/coastal ocean models and data assimilation schemes, together with remote sensed and in-situ observational data products) and building ad hoc co-designed end-user applications for an inspiring access to environmental data. 
NOW has a strong engagement with the Copernicus Marine Service (CMS), being operational provider (previously as Nologin) in 2 of its Production Centres: Nologin/NOW co-leads with MOI the CMS Iberian-Biscay-Ireland Monitoring and Forecasting Centre (IBI-MFC), being responsible of the operational delivery of near-real-time model forecasts and multi-year reanalysis model products for the European Atlantic façade. As partner of the CMS Insitu Thematic Assembly Centre (INS-TAC), NOW deals with the operational provision of in-situ observational products for the IBI region. 
NOW is quite experienced in product quality assessment, making combined uses of model, satellite and in-situ data sources, and generating new products using AI-based approaches.Together with the regional and coastal operational services focused on the near-real-time monitoring and short-term forecast, NOW Systems is contributing to build climate services, generating multi-year regional reanalysis products, and making coastal downscaling of climate change scenarios to generate appropriate ocean climate indicators.
NOW participates in several R&D projects and innovative actions at International, European and national level (i.e. through the EU H2020 and HE programmes, the UN Ocean Decade collaborative action, etc.). 
NOW Systems provides to its customers solutions, knowledge, and services for a more sustainable and cost-effective management of marine and coastal activities; being a reliable partner to build the operational services and Digital Twin approaches, needed and envisioned by our customers.

entityDescription: The Marine Optics and Remote Sensing research group (MarSens) was established in 2021 at Ghent University. The group is situated within the Biology Department of the Faculty of Sciences and is led by Professor Griet Neukermans. The MarSens team is specialized in (1) ocean colour remote sensing and atmospheric correction of optical satellite imagery; (2) above-water hyperspectral radiometry measurements; (3) modeling optical properties and biogeochemical characterization of marine particles; (4) development of optical remote sensing algorithms in coastal and open ocean waters; (5) development of optical sensors for particulate matter; (6) analyses of multiplatform in situ and remote sensing datasets. We embrace broad-ranging applications of ocean observation in marine biogeochemistry, plankton ecology, and water quality.

We’re building “Superlasers for the real world”. We offer innovative laser technologies and solutions, and effective applications in industry, while constantly pushing the boundaries of laser technology to benefit the Czech and European economy, as well as advancing laser use on Earth and beyond. - Space and defense laser technologies
- Smart & Safe Solutions for laser systems and applications
- Laser nanotechnology
- Laser technologies for compact particle and radiation sources

entityName: FUNDACIÓN ANDALUZA PARA EL DESARROLLO AEROESPACIAL - Avionic and Systems
entityDescription:
CATEC has a large experience developing UAS/RPAS technologies.
CATEC has also a wide experience working on European projects (FP7, H2020 SESAR and CleanSky), having participated in manyEuropean projects since 2008.
Avionics and Systems has two main strategic lines: Unmanned Aerial Systems, and the development of new ICT technologies to improve the efficiency of aeronautical manufacturing processes.

Avionics and Systemhas state of the art equipment and infrastructure that allow collaborating with the most relevant companies of this sector, to both development projects and also technology transfer.
CATEC counts with HW & SW laboratories with the equipment necessary for the development and integration of on-board systems in drones/UAS. The laboratories count with all the necessary tools, such as rapid prototyping machines, soldering and cabling tools, electronic instrumentation, etc. Its extension is 1.000m2 approximately.

CATECis the main Spanish technology center developing technologies for small and light drones. Avionics and Systems personnel have a large experience developing UAS/RPAS and aerial robotics technologies; CATEC has successfully developed many innovative technologies and participated in more than 100 R & D projects since 2008.
CATEC has a large expertise in developing new ICT technologies to improve efficiency in aeronautical manufacturing processes, working with large companies, such as engineering companies, and SMEs that are part of the Andalusian aeronautical sector.

entityDescription: Verkotan sees the world through antennas by providing wireless test services and solutions since 2015. Until now we have got over 200 hundred customers in more than 35 countries in six continents. Our customers vary from startups to Fortune 100 list companies having a radio and antenna in their products. Our roots are in cellular phones R&D, covering all technologies from the 1st generation to the upcoming 6th generation. With innovative attitude, skilled employees and decades of knowledge accumulated from working in the wireless industry, we can offer you leading design, testing and certification services. We provide OTA, Beamforming Antenna, RF Exposure, SAR and EMC testing, Tailored Test Solutions and consulting. We have developed active and passive antenna measurement systems based on NF-FF transformation for 5G beamforming antennas for FR1 and FR2 upto 200 GHz. We are active in EU R&D projects with partners to explore new state of the art solutions. We are a fast, flexible and reliable partner with our customers’ R&D and we always find the best testing solutions to match our customers’ needs. Our operations are ISO17025 accredited and our quality management system is ISO9001 certified. Our laboratories are located in Oulu RadioPark, Finland.
